## Where Do Sodium's Electrons Go?

A sodium atom has 11 electrons. In the last lesson you saw that K is the lowest shell, the one nearest the nucleus, so an electron in K has the least energy.

**Predict:** Where do sodium's 11 electrons sit?

options.text: All 11 sit in the K-shell, because K has the lowest energy.
Some sit in K and the rest in shells further out, because a shell holds only so many.
They spread out evenly, with about the same number in every shell.
